candidate_scope: No live installation, no disable-default, no registry migration. This is a backup/rollback rehearsal plan for a future separately authorized P5 operation.

backup_plan.location: disposable scratch (0700) outside discovery roots; exact root assigned at execution time
backup_plan.rule: per-file byte copy + SHA-256 + mode; no overwrite of unrelated later changes; expected-current-state hash check before any apply

apply_rehearsal: Copy each candidate file into disposable 0700 scratch preserve bytes/mode
Compute before hashes and backup manifest
Apply candidate discovery/disable transformation ONLY to scratch copies
Verify intended transformed bytes and parity expectations
rollback_rehearsal: Restore from backup into scratch by byte comparison
Assert each restored file SHA-256 equals recorded before hash
Assert no file outside scratch changed; sentinel outside root unchanged
Report ROLLBACK_VERIFIED with exact 5-file digest list or precise failure
